description: This file defines a mock class for the IDecryptionService interface used in testing the decryption service within the Rialto server component. It includes mock methods for decrypting media, checking key system type, selecting key IDs, and managing session usage counters.

classes.name: DecryptionServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IDecryptionService interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Mocks the decryption method for a given key session, encrypted buffer, and caps.

methods.name: decrypt (overloaded)
methods.description: Mocks the decryption method with additional parameters including subsample, IV, key ID, and initialization flag.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Mocks the check for whether the key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks the selection of a key ID for a given session.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Mocks incrementing the usage counter for a session ID.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Mocks decrementing the usage counter for a session ID.
